verdict.rationale: Unity ships Sentis (com.unity.ai.inference), an official neural-network inference library that lets developers import trained models and run them on-device with the target platform's compute resources — directly matching the story. This is corroborated by both the package manual and a live runtime probe confirming the package resolves via Unity's package registry. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on developer validation of Sentis in shipped games, platform-coverage specifics, and performance benchmarks.
